content.social_links_info: Edit the links in Theme settings > Social media.
content.social_media_info: Used by the social links block and your store's search engine data.

info.accent_color: Used for links, focus outlines, and highlighted labels.
info.adaptive_text: Text turns dark over light areas and light over dark ones, such as photos, so it stays readable. Uses white text; logo images are shown inverted too.
info.animations_button_bubble: A circle of the hover color fills the button while its label rolls through.
info.animations_page_transition: The clicked product image grows into the product page as the page wipes in from the right. Works in Chrome, Edge and Safari; other browsers load the page as usual.
info.animations_reveal_on_scroll: Section content rises, sharpens and fades in as it scrolls into view, one item after another, and plays again when you scroll back.
info.animations_smooth_scroll: Mouse and touchpad scrolling glides to a stop. Touch screens keep their own scrolling.
info.animations_text_roll: Letters of text links slide down one after another when hovered.
info.autoplay: Autoplaying videos are muted and loop.
info.autoplay_speed: Set to 0 to turn off rotating announcements.
info.bundle_products: Used when the product has no complementary products in the Search & Discovery app.
info.button_hover_fill: The circle that fills the button on hover. Pick a color that contrasts with the button for a bolder effect.
info.card_background: A solid color or gradient behind every product card. Leave empty for none.
info.card_background_area: Image fills the space around transparent product photos.
info.card_show_product_type: For example a mood like "Calm & grounding". Set it as the product type in the Shopify admin.
info.cart_recommendations: Based on the products in the cart. Shown in the cart drawer.
info.chips_menu: Shown as chips in the mobile menu. Names listed in Theme settings > Swatches get their color.
info.collection_image: Leave empty to use the collection image.
info.collection_product_slides: Only for collections with more than one product.
info.comparison_product: Shown as a link on the photo.
info.contact_address: Leave empty to show the store's address from Settings > General.
info.countdown_date: Year-month-day, for example 2026-12-24. In the store time zone.
info.countdown_expired: Leave empty to hide the timer once it ends.
info.currency_format: Uses your store's money format from Settings > General.
info.custom_font_sizes: Overrides the design sizes and weights for every text in this section. Large headings shrink on mobile.
info.custom_liquid: Add app snippets or other code to create advanced customizations.
info.customer_account_menu: Links in the account sheet, such as Orders and Profile. Leave empty to use the customer accounts menu from Content > Menus.
info.customer_count: Shown in the last circle, such as 12K+.
info.drawer_corner_radius: Drawers with rounded corners float away from the screen edge.
info.dynamic_checkout: Customers see their preferred payment method, like PayPal or Apple Pay.
info.empty_cart_button_link: Shown when no products are chosen below.
info.empty_cart_collection: Products shown while the cart is empty.
info.empty_cart_products: Shown in the empty cart drawer with an Add button. Products with several variants link to their page instead.
info.featured_collection: Shown as a large banner above the grid.
info.featured_launch_heading: Leave empty to use the product name.
info.featured_launch_image: Leave empty to use the product photo.
info.featured_launch_text: Leave empty to use the start of the product description.
info.filtering: Customize filters with the Search & Discovery app.
info.footer_background_style: The animated grain gradient drifts slowly and follows the cursor. It stays still for customers who prefer reduced motion.
info.free_shipping_threshold: Amount in your store's default currency. Set it to match your shipping rates.
info.gradient_color: The footer fades from the page background into this color. Leave empty to use the accent color.
info.guide_content: Shown under the tables. Connect a product metafield to show each product its own notes.
info.guide_option: Option name, for example Size. Leave empty for the first option.
info.guide_page: For long guides or tables. Replaces the text above.
info.guide_tables: One row per line, cells split by |. The first row is the header. # Title names a table; a blank line starts a new one. Connect a product metafield to give each product its own.
info.header_background_color: Leave empty to use the page background color.
info.header_menu: Sub-items open a drop-down. Sub-items with their own links open a mega menu, with one column each.
info.header_text_color: Leave empty to use the page text color (light text when transparent).
info.hero_cards_product: Shown as a card over the second image.
info.hero_product_image: Fills the panel. Leave empty to use the product image.
info.hero_product_text: Leave empty to use the start of the product description.
info.hotspot_product: Shows the product image, price, and an Add button.
info.inverse_text_color: Text on dark or accent backgrounds, such as primary buttons.
info.italic_words: Set words in italics to style them like the design.
info.last_updated: Leave empty to use the date the page was published.
info.layout_width: Normal keeps the content within the page width. Wide runs it edge to edge; use Left and Right padding to add space.
info.loop_duration: Time for one full pass. Higher is slower.
info.menu_item: The name of the top menu item whose mega menu shows this promo, such as "Shop".
info.mood_card_color: Leave empty to use the color listed for this name in Theme settings > Swatches.
info.note_image: Shown in the circle instead of the color.
info.opening_hours: For example 10am–7pm. Leave a day empty when the store is closed.
info.page_hero_heading: Leave empty to show the page title.
info.panel_heading: Shown on its side while the panel is closed.
info.password_text: Leave empty to show the message from Online Store > Preferences.
info.policy_menu: Leave empty to list your store policies.
info.policy_summary: One point per line. Shown in a card above the page content.
info.popover_overlay_color: Dims the page behind modals, popups, and drawers.
info.predictive_search: Suggests products, collections, pages, and articles in the search drawer.
info.predictive_search_collection: Suggested products before the customer starts typing.
info.product_card_background: Overrides the card background from Theme settings.
info.product_guide: A link beside an option label opens the guide in a modal. Hidden when the guide is empty.
info.product_meta_text: Connect a product metafield so each product shows its own line. An empty eyebrow shows the product type.
info.promo_link: Leave empty to link to the product.
info.promo_placement: The row comes from Show after product. On phones with two columns, Center spans the full width.
info.promo_position: The tile takes the place of a product; 0 hides it.
info.promo_product: Shows its price and, without an image, its photo.
info.quick_add: Opens a quick view on desktop and a bottom sheet on mobile.
info.reviews_anchor: The rating links to the section with this ID on the page.
info.satisfaction_score: Out of 5, such as 4.8. Leave empty to hide.
info.section_anchor: Links like #reviews scroll to this section.
info.show_follow_on_shop: Shows when Shop Pay is turned on for your store.
info.show_installments: Shop Pay Installments, when it is turned on for your store.
info.show_localization: Shows when you sell in more than one country or language.
info.show_rating: Uses the product rating metafield from your reviews app.
info.show_social_icons: Edit the links in Theme settings > Social media.
info.show_tag_badges: Add a product tag starting with "badge:" — for example badge:New or badge:Bestseller.
info.social_handle_link: Leave empty to use Instagram from Theme settings > Social media.
info.social_links_from_settings: Links come from Theme settings > Social media.
info.spotlight_overlay: Darkens the top of the image so the text stays readable.
info.sticky_image: On large screens the image stays pinned while the products scroll. Off: it scrolls with them.
info.sticky_media: On large screens, while the product details scroll.
info.stockist_coordinates: Places the pin and measures distance. In Google Maps, right-click the store and click the numbers to copy them, for example 40.6928, -73.9903.
info.stockists_filters: Filter stores by what they carry, set on each store.
info.subheading_font: Used for navigation, buttons, and small labels.
info.suggested_collection: Products shown when a search finds nothing.
info.swatch_option_names: Option names separated by commas. Matching is not case-sensitive.
info.swatch_values: One value per line, as "Value: color" or "Value: file name". Use a hex code like #E8B4B8, or the name of an image uploaded in Content > Files. Swatches set up in Shopify (category metafields) are used first.
info.tabs_layout: Featured grid shows five products: the first large, four beside it.
info.transparent_home_only: Other pages use a solid header. Turn off to place the header over the first section on every page.
info.ugc_counts: Shown with a heart and a speech bubble, for example 1.2k. Leave empty to hide.
info.ugc_product: Large tiles only. Shown as their signature scent.
info.upsell_heading: Leave empty to show the product title.
info.video_card_image: Shown when there is no video.
info.wordmark_text: Any word or short phrase, such as your brand name or a tagline. Leave empty to use the store name. The size adjusts to the length.

html_defaults.about_text: We began with a simple question: what if your fragrance could help you feel the way you want to feel?
html_defaults.accordion_content_1: Orders leave our studio within one business day. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days.
html_defaults.accordion_content_2: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Opened scents can be swapped once.
html_defaults.accordion_content_3: We ship to the US, Canada, the UK and the EU. International orders arrive in 5–10 business days.
html_defaults.brand_intro_text: Every scent starts with a feeling. We pair botanicals traditionally used for that mood with modern perfumery, so your fragrance does more than smell good.
html_defaults.brand_story_text: Born from slow mornings and long walks, our scents blend botanicals with modern perfumery to support how you want to feel — honest ingredients, thoughtful sourcing, and scents that move with your rhythm.
html_defaults.column_text: Every scent starts with plants chosen for how they make you feel.
html_defaults.community_text: Real rituals from real people. See how our community makes our scents part of their everyday moods.

html_defaults.footer_text: Botanical eau de parfums, each composed around how you want to feel.
html_defaults.heading: Scent, made for a feeling
html_defaults.hero_text: Botanical eau de parfums, each composed around a feeling — from calm to confidence.
html_defaults.icon_text_2: Changed your mind? Send it back within 30 days.
html_defaults.ingredient_1: (Ficus carica) A green, milky note gathered from Mediterranean fig trees. It gives the scent its fresh, grounded lift — bright at first breath, then softly creamy.
html_defaults.ingredient_2: (Schinus molle) A sparkling, rosy spice that opens the scent with a quick lift of energy.
html_defaults.ingredient_3: (Iris pallida) A powdery, velvety root that brings poise and a quiet elegance to the heart.
html_defaults.ingredient_4: A warm, resinous glow that wraps the base in comfort and stays close to skin.
html_defaults.ingredient_5: (Cedrus atlantica) A dry, steady wood that grounds the blend and helps it last.
html_defaults.ingredients_text: Five botanicals form the heart of this scent. Each one is chosen for how it makes you feel — together they build a scent that is bright, steady and quietly confident.
html_defaults.origin_text:
We started in a small studio with a perfumer, a botanist and a wall of mood boards. Every scent is built backwards: first the feeling, then the plants traditionally linked to it, then the composition.

The result is a collection of six genderless eau de parfums, body veils and home scents designed to be worn on purpose.
html_defaults.promo_text: Six 2ml vials in a keepsake box. Wear each for a day, then claim $15 back toward your full-size favourite.
html_defaults.ritual_text: Each bottle comes with an intention card. Pair the scent with a few words, and let the moment anchor the mood.
html_defaults.section_text: Share a short line about this section.
html_defaults.text: We pair botanicals with modern perfumery, so every scent supports how you want to feel — calm, joyful or ready for anything.
